label-disabled.$description: Mirrors NSColor.disabledControlTextColor; kit-27 dark disabled labels use Labels/Dark/3 Tertiary

window-bg.$description: Live-system eyedrop of the dark System Settings pane; matches the kit-27 Window Backgrounds/Dark swatch and the kit-27 field idle fill. User feedback: prior #323232 read too light

control-bg.$description: Kit-27 dark input-field fill. Mirrors NSColor.controlBackgroundColor — background of content areas (lists, tables). Not the button bezel — use `control` for bezels

control-bg-disabled.$description: Kit-27 dark disabled input-field fill: #1E1E1E at 0.5

control.$description: Kit-27 dark toggles use Fills/Dark/1 Primary; dark neutral buttons are #FFF 7% — the toggle scale wins, divergence noted in 11-tahoe-metrics

control-disabled-strong.$description: Kit-27 dark unchecked-disabled fill (0.05) at 2×: consumers are additionally dimmed by disabled-opacity 0.5, so the effective fill matches the kit

control-track-pressed.$description: Approximation: kit-27 dark clicked track is a flat #FFF 19%

content-bg.$description: Live-system eyedrop: content card/group fill on dark panes

accent-hover.$description: unverified. The Tahoe kit has no hover for bordered controls

accent-pressed.$description: Kit-27 dark pressed overlay on accent toggles: #FFF 8%

accent-pressed-soft.$description: Kit-27 dark prominent clicked: plus-lighter accent + #FFF 10% (plus-lighter base approximated by the accent itself)

accent-disabled.$description: Kit-27 dark disabled prominent-button fill: accent at opacity 0.4

accent-disabled-strong.$description: Kit-27 dark disabled checked toggle sits at opacity 0.45; doubled to compensate the disabled-opacity 0.5 row dim

focus-ring.$description: unverified. Kit 27 has no dark focus masters; light formula kept

focus-ring-border.$description: unverified. Kit 27 has no dark focus masters; light formula kept

label-on-accent-disabled.$description: Kit-27 dark disabled prominent buttons dim the white label to opacity 0.5

destructive-bg.$description: Kit-27 dark Bordered Destructive: (red + #FFF 14%) at opacity 0.2; white tint dropped

destructive-bg-pressed.$description: Kit-27 dark clicked: same stack at opacity 0.28

separator-vibrant.$description: Kit-27 stepper separator: Dark Vibrant 4 Quaternary

border-control.$description: Kit-27 dark input-field border: rgba(255,255,255,0.04), 1px outside

material-glass-regular-bg.$description: Liquid Glass Dark/Regular - Medium top fill

material-glass-regular-shadow.$description: Practical subset of the kit Dark/Regular - Medium shadow pack: drops + rim speculars (rim alphas approximated)

shadow-switch-track.$description: unverified. Kit-27 dark off-track has no ring; light value kept

shadow-switch-thumb.$description: unverified. Kit-26 light subset; kit-27 dark shows a simplified 0 3 36 shadow
